# 📋 Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

This project is developed in an academic environment at **Haramaya University**. Everyone who interacts with this project — contributors, users, reviewers — is expected to maintain a respectful and professional environment.

---

## ✅ Expected Behaviour

- Be respectful and considerate in all interactions
- Give and receive constructive feedback gracefully
- Focus on what is best for the project and learning community
- Show empathy toward other contributors regardless of experience level
- Credit others' work and ideas appropriately

---

## ❌ Unacceptable Behaviour

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks of any kind
- Dismissing contributions because of someone's background or skill level
- Publishing others' private information without permission
- Plagiarism — submitting this project as your own coursework without proper attribution

---

## 🎓 Academic Integrity

This project is an academic submission. If you use or reference this code:

- You must provide proper attribution to the original authors
- Do not submit this work as your own university assignment
- Using it as a **learning reference** is encouraged and welcome

---

## 📣 Reporting Issues

If you experience or witness unacceptable behaviour, please contact the project author directly:

- 📧 Email: gemachistesfaye@email.com
- ✈️ Telegram: [@GemachisTech](https://t.me/GemachisTech)

All reports will be handled with confidentiality and respect.

---

## ⚖️ Enforcement

Project maintainers have the right to remove comments, commits, or contributions that violate this Code of Conduct and to ban contributors who behave inappropriately.

---

*This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.*
